programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23
programmes.d: A mill on the boarder of England and Wales with a history of death, Chirk Mill is said to have its fair share of ghosts. The team split up and soon find that something is their in the dark.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23
programmes.d: Yvette and her team continue their investigation into Chirk Mill, where one entity seems eager to play a tune.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Royal Court Theatre - Bacup
programmes.d: The world famous ghost hunting team return for a new series and start in a small theatre with a big problem…ghosts.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Delapre Abbey
programmes.d: The team are joined by five members of the English rugby team as they investigate an all but forgotten piece of British history.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Drakelow Tunnels
programmes.d: p 8: Drakelow Tunnels - Kidderminster: With over 4 miles of haunted tunnels the team have one night to investigate this labyrinth of horror.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The National Emergency Services Gallery
programmes.d: A terrifying place full of history and paranormal activity. The team are tested as the try to find the spirits that refuse to leave this famous location.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The Galleries of Justice
programmes.d: The legendary ghost hunters continue in Nottingham and a place where people could be jailed, sentenced and executed without even leaving the building.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Newton House Part 1
programmes.d: The first of a two-part investigation with celebrity guests, world famous band ‘Bullet for My Valentine’.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Newton House Part 2
programmes.d: Part 2 of this spin-chilling episode. Nursing their wounds from the last episode the team and their celebrity guests ‘Bullet For My Valentine’ carry on.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Saltmarshe Hall Part 1
programmes.d: Saltmarshe Hall is a mysterious, haunted house of complete contrasts. Beneath the property lies a network of corridors and cellar rooms and the abandoned North Wing has sat empty for over 70 years,

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Saltmarshe Hall Part 2
programmes.d: Saltmarshe Hall is a mysterious, haunted house of complete contrasts. Beneath the property lies a network of corridors and cellar rooms and the abandoned North Wing has sat empty for over 70 years,

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Ye Olde Kings Head
programmes.d: The Great British pub may be on the decline but in some paranormal activity seems to be on the rise and the Ye Olde Kings Head is one of the most haunted.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: The Tivoli Venue
programmes.d: A well-known venue for accomplished as well as up and coming bands The Tivoli Venue boasts many a ghost. In this episode one of the team gets a warning from the other side that reduces them to tears and something seems to be stalking the team.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Tatton Hall
programmes.d: Something about Tatton Old Hall keeps bringing the Most Haunted team back. Something happens that stops two of the team entering, a poltergeist causes confusion and the team get a clear voice from beyond the veil.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Fort Paull Part 1
programmes.d: Part 1 of this terrifying place concentrates above ground. The team are alarmed at the results from a new piece of equipment and Yvette meets her match.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Fort Paull Part 2
programmes.d: Part 2. The Most Haunted team explore the underground of Fort Paull. With its foundations and footprint dating back 100’s of years the team are faced with some terrifying ordeals.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Annison Funeral Parlour
programmes.d: Coffins, murder and a malevolent spirit plague the team as they investigate this one-time funeral home. With one member isolated alone another in a coffin the team catch a poltergeist in action

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Wentworth Woodhouse Part 1
programmes.d: Part 1. The upper floors of Wentworth House are a maze of corridors and rooms and the team have one night to investigate as many as possible. With one whistling spirit, groans and loud noises the team are shaken to their core.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Wentworth Woodhouse Part 2
programmes.d: Part 2. The underbelly of this great house is a sharp contrast to its upper grandeur. Some members of the team are forced to run while other are lost in the labyrinth of tunnels and passageways pursued by something unnatural.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Oakwell House
programmes.d: The team investigate Oakwell House near Leeds, which was built by ancestors of Fred Batt. In 1684, William Batt returned unexpectedly from a trip to London but vanished leaving a bloody footprint. A demon dog has been seen in the grounds.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Knottingley Town Hall
programmes.d: This location is said to be overflowing with paranormal activity, which doesn’t disappoint.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Capesthorne Hall
programmes.d: The beauty of this magnificent Cheshire country house hides the horror that lies in its corridors. As well a poltergeist activity the team manage to catch some of their best evidence to date and even our sceptic hears noises.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: 30 East Drive_PT1
programmes.d: 30 East Drive is said to house the most violent poltergeist in the world. The team go head first into what becomes their toughest challenge yet. As soon as they enter the property something is waiting and wants to be known.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: 30 East Drive_PT2
programmes.d: The team continue their most threatening investigation yet and for some they will be scared for life mentally and physically. The most violent poltergeist in the world is ready for a fight...but who wins?

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Thackray Museum
programmes.d: The medical museum houses a great many objects from its distant hospital and workhouse past with a complete Victorian street scene on the lower level.

programmes.t: Most Haunted S16-23: Armley Mills
programmes.d: Once the centre of industry Armley Mills is now a museum that is said to house the phantoms of many a lost soul. From children who were caught in the machinery to a bad tempered floorwalker who doesn’t like people in his mill.
